deviations.what: The imperative token interaction is dropped: the tokenDelete event handler on all four OverflowToolbarTokenizers and the press handler on the 'Add Token' Button are removed. The original controller mutates static Token child controls via addToken/removeToken plus a MessageToast - imperative control mutation over static (non-bound) tokens, not expressible without inventing a bound token model. All controls, tokens and every other attribute are kept 1:1.
sap.m.OverflowToolbar ariaHasPopup (since 1.79.0) is kept 1:1 from the original view; needs a UI5 release >= 1.79 to render.
